profile_text.body:
Lovable is a software company founded in 2023 that operates an AI-powered platform for building apps, websites, and digital products. The company describes its platform as enabling users to create software without deep coding skills, positioning it toward individuals and employees at established companies who want to build and ship digital tools quickly.

The platform's core product, also called Lovable, falls in the coding and developer tools category and is oriented around AI-assisted app generation. The site describes an iterative workflow in which users refine a project until satisfied and then deploy it immediately, with the company noting that businesses use the platform to build internal software.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP registry presence, or SEC disclosures are recorded in the held facts for Lovable.
